title: Telemetry
description: LDS-L1 canonical telemetry message (doc 44 G2.5). Published on syn/{site}/{area}/{line}/{cell}/{equip}/telemetry. additionalProperties stays open so producers can ADD fields (BACKWARD-safe); removing/retyping a field or adding a new required field is a breaking change caught by the registry gate.

asset_id.description: Canonical asset identifier (registry id, not raw DB id)

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the sample batch

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number for gap/duplicate detection
